unset DISPLAY WAYLAND_DISPLAY DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS
export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen
export HOME=/home/user
FREECAD_SNAP=$(readlink -f /snap/freecad/current 2>/dev/null || true)
KF6_SNAP=$(readlink -f /snap/kf6-core24/current 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -n "$FREECAD_SNAP" ]; then
  export PATH="$FREECAD_SNAP/usr/bin:$PATH"
  export PYTHONPATH="$FREECAD_SNAP/usr/lib:$FREECAD_SNAP/usr/Mod${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
  export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$FREECAD_SNAP/usr/lib:$FREECAD_SNAP/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu${KF6_SNAP:+:$KF6_SNAP/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu}${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
fi
cd /home/user
python3 -c "
import FreeCAD
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument('Unnamed')
part = doc.addObject('Part::Line', 'Line1')
part.Point1 = FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0)
part.Point2 = FreeCAD.Vector(10, 0, 0)
doc.recompute()
doc.save('/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd')
print('Document saved successfully')
"
